summary: Teardown does not cancel the in-flight backend job; remount starts a new request that queues on the same Mutex, so repeated subtab switches accumulate blocked threads; the comment claims a hung poll cannot pile up
evidence: Home.svelte:11-13 comment; :37-40 teardown flips active only; commands.rs:56 spawn_blocking; windows/mod.rs:47 lock held; ComputerPage.svelte:8-12 remounts on each subtab switch
failure_scenario: Switching Computer subtabs N times during a slow call leaves up to N threads waiting on the Mutex; all but the last result are discarded. Related FND-0039. UNVERIFIED blocking duration.
resolution_note: Re-verifier CONFIRM-PARTIAL. Accepted residual: the narrowed lock removes the mutex queue, but hung-disk enumerations now run concurrently and the 10 s timeout abandons one backend call per 10 s during a persistent hang. No backend cancel. Tracked as FND-0211.
